reason: One unguarded access exists, not several: packages/core/EventManager.ts:118-119 destructures `[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` and reads `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without `?.`, which throws a TypeError when a Google Meet booking has no destination calendar (handleNewBooking sets it to null in that case). Every other destructuring site (larkcalendar, office365calendar, googlecalendar, packages/lib/CalendarService.ts, BrokenIntegrationEmail.tsx) guards with `?.` or a truthiness check.
